     1→<!DOCTYPE html>
     2→<html lang="es">
     3→<head>
     4→<meta charset="UTF-8">
     5→<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
     6→<title>Arcano - Subir a GitHub</title>
     7→<style>
     8→*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
     9→body{font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;background:#0d1117;color:#c9d1d9;min-height:100vh;padding:20px}
    10→.container{max-width:600px;margin:0 auto}
    11→h1{color:#f0c040;font-size:1.5rem;margin-bottom:6px}
    12→.sub{color:#8b949e;font-size:.85rem;margin-bottom:24px}
    13→.card{background:#161b22;border:1px solid #30363d;border-radius:12px;padding:20px;margin-bottom:16px}
    14→label{display:block;font-size:.75rem;font-weight:700;color:#8b949e;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;margin-bottom:5px}
    15→input{width:100%;background:#0d1117;border:1px solid #30363d;border-radius:8px;color:#c9d1d9;font-size:.9rem;padding:10px 12px;outline:none;margin-bottom:12px}
    16→input:focus{border-color:#f0c040}
    17→.btn{width:100%;border:none;border-radius:8px;font-size:1rem;font-weight:700;padding:14px;cursor:pointer;transition:opacity .2s}
    18→.btn:hover{opacity:.9}
    19→.btn-go{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#c9963a,#e8b84b);color:#1a0e00}
    20→.btn-go:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed}
    21→.log{background:#0d1117;border:1px solid #30363d;border-radius:8px;padding:12px;font-family:'SF Mono',Monaco,monospace;font-size:.78rem;max-height:300px;overflow-y:auto;margin-top:12px}
    22→.log div{padding:3px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #21262d}
    23→.log .ok{color:#3fb950}
    24→.log .err{color:#f85149}
    25→.log .info{color:#58a6ff}
    26→.progress{background:#21262d;border-radius:8px;height:8px;margin-top:12px;overflow:hidden}
    27→.progress-bar{height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#c9963a,#e8b84b);border-radius:8px;transition:width .3s;width:0%}
    28→.steps{margin-top:16px}
    29→.step{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:8px 0;font-size:.85rem;color:#8b949e}
    30→.step .icon{width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:.7rem;background:#21262d;flex-shrink:0}
    31→.step.done .icon{background:#238636;color:#fff}
    32→.step.active .icon{background:#f0c040;color:#1a0e00}
    33→.step.error .icon{background:#da3633;color:#fff}
    34→.step.done{color:#3fb950}
    35→.step.error{color:#f85149}
    36→</style>
    37→</head>
    38→<body>
    39→<div class="container">
    40→  <h1>Arcano - Deploy a GitHub</h1>
    41→  <p class="sub">Sube todos los archivos de la app directamente a tu repositorio usando la API de GitHub.</p>
    42→  <div class="card">
    43→    <label>Owner / Usuario de GitHub</label>
    44→    <input id="inp-owner" value="arcanoespecias" placeholder="ej: mi-usuario">
    45→    <label>Repositorio</label>
    46→    <input id="inp-repo" value="arcano-app" placeholder="ej: mi-repo">
    47→    <label>Branch</label>
    48→    <input id="inp-branch" value="main" placeholder="main">
    49→    <label>Personal Access Token (PAT)</label>
    50→    <input id="inp-token" type="password" placeholder="ghp_xxxxxxxxxxxx">
    51→    <p style="font-size:.75rem;color:#8b949e;margin-bottom:12px">Si no tenes un token: anda a GitHub &rarr; Settings &rarr; Developer settings &rarr; Personal access tokens &rarr; Generate new token (Classic). Dale permiso de <strong>repo</strong> (completo).</p>
    52→    <button class="btn btn-go" id="btn-upload" onclick="startUpload()">Subir todo al repositorio</button>
    53→    <div class="progress" id="progress-wrap" style="display:none"><div class="progress-bar" id="progress-bar"></div></div>
    54→  </div>
    55→  <div class="card" id="steps-card" style="display:none"><div class="steps" id="steps"></div></div>
    56→  <div class="card" id="log-card" style="display:none"><label>Log</label><div class="log" id="log"></div></div>
    57→  <div class="card" id="done-card" style="display:none">
    58→    <div style="text-align:center;padding:10px 0"><div style="font-size:2.5rem;margin-bottom:8px">&#9989;</div><div style="font-size:1.1rem;font-weight:700;color:#3fb950">Todos los archivos subidos</div><p style="color:#8b949e;margin-top:8px;font-size:.85rem">Tu app deberia estar disponible en segundos en:</p><a id="app-url" href="#" target="_blank" style="color:#f0c040;font-size:.9rem;word-break:break-all"></a><p style="color:#8b949e;margin-top:12px;font-size:.78rem">Abri la app con ?nocache=1 para forzar recarga.</p></div>
    59→  </div>
    60→</div>
    61→<script>
    62→var FILES = {"index.html": "", "css/style.css": "", "js/db.js": "", "js/github-sync.js": "", "js/modules1.js": "", "js/modules2.js": "", "manifest.json": "", "icons/icon-192.png": "", "icons/icon-512.png": "", "icons/logo-header.png": "", "icons/logo-pin.png": "", "icons/favicon.png": ""};
    63→function addLog(msg,type){var l=document.getElementById('log'),d=document.createElement('div');d.className=type||'';d.textContent=msg;l.appendChild(d);l.scrollTop=l.scrollHeight;}
    64→function updateStep(i,status){var s=document.querySelectorAll('.step');if(s[i])s[i].className='step '+status;}
    65→function setProgress(p){document.getElementById('progress-bar').style.width=p+'%';}
    66→async function githubPut(owner,repo,path,contentB64,branch,token,sha){var url='https://api.github.com/repos/'+owner+'/'+repo+'/contents/'+path;var body={message:'Arcano v14 deploy',content:contentB64,branch:branch};if(sha)body.sha=sha;var r=await fetch(url,{method:'PUT',headers:{'Authorization':'Bearer '+token,'Accept':'application/vnd.github.v3+json','Content-Type':'application/json','User-Agent':'Arcano-Deploy'},body:JSON.stringify(body)});if(!r.ok){var e=await r.json().catch(function(){return {};});throw new Error(e.message||'Error HTTP '+r.status);}return r.json();}
    67→async function githubGetSha(owner,repo,path,branch,token){try{var url='https://api.github.com/repos/'+owner+'/'+repo+'/contents/'+path+'?ref='+branch;var r=await fetch(url,{headers:{'Authorization':'Bearer '+token,'Accept':'application/vnd.github.v3+json','User-Agent':'Arcano-Deploy'}});if(r.status===404)return null;if(!r.ok)throw new Error('Error '+r.status);var d=await r.json();return d.sha;}catch(e){return null;}}
    68→async function startUpload(){
    69→  var owner=document.getElementById('inp-owner').value.trim(),repo=document.getElementById('inp-repo').value.trim(),branch=document.getElementById('inp-branch').value.trim()||'main',token=document.getElementById('inp-token').value.trim();
    70→  if(!owner||!repo||!token){alert('Completar owner, repo y token');return;}
    71→  var btn=document.getElementById('btn-upload');btn.disabled=true;btn.textContent='Subiendo...';
    72→  document.getElementById('progress-wrap').style.display='block';document.getElementById('steps-card').style.display='block';document.getElementById('log-card').style.display='block';document.getElementById('done-card').style.display='none';
    73→  var filePaths=Object.keys(FILES),stepsEl=document.getElementById('steps');
    74→  stepsEl.innerHTML=filePaths.map(function(p){return '<div class="step" id="step-'+p.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/gi,'-')+'"><div class="icon">-</div><span>'+p+'</span></div>';}).join('');
    75→  addLog('Iniciando deploy a '+owner+'/'+repo+' ('+branch+')','info');addLog('Archivos: '+filePaths.length,'info');
    76→  var ok=0,fail=0;
    77→  for(var i=0;i<filePaths.length;i++){
    78→    var fp=filePaths[i];updateStep(i,'active');setProgress(Math.round((i/filePaths.length)*100));
    79→    try{var sha=await githubGetSha(owner,repo,fp,branch,token);if(sha)addLog(fp+' existe, actualizando...','info');else addLog(fp+' nuevo, creando...','info');await githubPut(owner,repo,fp,FILES[fp],branch,token,sha);addLog(fp+' - OK','ok');updateStep(i,'done');ok++;}
    80→    catch(e){addLog(fp+' - ERROR: '+e.message,'err');updateStep(i,'error');fail++;}
    81→    if(i<filePaths.length-1)await new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,500);});
    82→  }
    83→  setProgress(100);
    84→  if(fail===0){addLog('DEPLOY COMPLETADO - '+ok+'/'+filePaths.length+' OK','ok');document.getElementById('done-card').style.display='block';var u='https://'+owner+'.github.io/'+repo+'/';document.getElementById('app-url').href=u;document.getElementById('app-url').textContent=u;}
    85→  else addLog('ERRORES: '+ok+' OK, '+fail+' fallaron','err');
    86→  btn.disabled=false;btn.textContent=fail===0?'Subido':'Reintentar';
    87→}
    88→</script>
    89→</body>
    90→</html>
